prompt: Fill in the blanks to complete the description of symmetric encryption.
template: Alice wants to send Bob a love letter that no eavesdropper can read. She scrambles the {{blank1}} into unreadable {{blank2}} using a shared secret {{blank3}}. Only Bob, holding the same secret, can reverse the process and recover her words.
explanation: Plaintext is the original message, the key is the shared secret used to transform it, and ciphertext is the scrambled result an eavesdropper can't read without that same key.
